5231-7084-8347.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2105-4598-5434-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-4598-5434-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-4598-5434-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Essence Flux from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Essence Flux from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

401-1531-3944-8125.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-1531-3944-8125.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Davvol triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Deathgreeter trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat.

618-728-1938.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Glorious Protector.
When the Glorious Protector token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Glorious Protector token.
When the Glorious Protector token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two lore counters on it

957-2493-7879.easyPrerequisites: You have at least eight cards in hand.
957-2493-7879.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Great Synthesis triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its third chapter ability then triggers, causing you to cast Time Stretch and Archaeomancer without paying their mana costs, and then exiling The Great Synthesis and returning it to the battlefield as Jin-Gitaxias.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Resolve the Archaeomancer spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Jin-Gitaxias by paying {3}{U}, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as The Great Synthesis.
When The Great Synthesis enters with a lore counter on it, its first ability triggers, causing you to draw cards equal to the number of cards in your hand and not have a maximum hand size for the rest of the game.
Move to your first extra turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Great Synthesis triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, returning all non-Phyrexian creatures (including Archaeomancer) from the battlefield to their owner's hand.
Repeat from step 1 during your second extra turn
957-2493-7879.notes: The combo is listed as near-infinite turns because you'll draw cards at a much faster rate than normal, which will result in you getting less turns.

3375-4399-4770-5789.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Lifecreed Duo trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Lifecreed Duo trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3375-4399-4770-5789.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3010-3259-4742.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3010-3259-4742.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Moonblade Shinobi, triggering Breath of Fury and Moonblade Shinobi.
Resolve the Moonblade Shinobi trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

670-1619-6143-6966.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-6143-6966.description:
Cast All-Fates Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the All-Fates Stalker trigger, exiling Feywild Caretaker until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice All-Fates Stalker.
All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, causing Feywild Caretaker to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Feywild Caretaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning All-Fates Stalker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the All-Fates Stalker trigger, exiling Feywild Caretaker until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice All-Fates Stalker.
Repeat from step 5.

423-1437-3177-3756--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1437-3177-3756--85.description:
Cast Sakura-Tribe Scout by paying {G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Sakura-Tribe Scout spell three times.
Resolve the first Sakura-Tribe Scout copy.
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

57-283-4846-7175.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{R}.
57-283-4846-7175.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

339-677-6798-7175.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

215-4010-6723-6968.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-4010-6723-6968.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

5641-5805-6012.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
5641-5805-6012.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Reluctant Role Model's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

4681-4730-5231-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Sparring Mummy, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sparring Mummy from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sparring Mummy enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

224-4913-5310-5621.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, causing you to draw a card and put Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield, and then repeat this process once if you control eight or more lands, putting any other land from your hand onto the battlefield instead.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Bloodghast and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodghast trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone and Dina.
Repeat.

1737-2103-2707-6504.manaNeeded: {1} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
1737-2103-2707-6504.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Conjurer's Bauble.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate the Conjurer's Bauble token by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Capture of Jingzhou onto the bottom of your library from your graveyard, and then causing you to draw Capture of Jingzhou from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat each turn.

3129-4365-5658-6245.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least six permanents.
3129-4365-5658-6245.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating four token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers four times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining trigger.
3129-4365-5658-6245.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

2292-3951-5703-5744.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
2292-3951-5703-5744.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

2011-5956.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater that does not have summoning sickness, and that cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
2011-5956.description:
Declare any creature with power 5 or greater that cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent as an attacker.
Shriekwood Devourer triggers, and Najeela triggers if a Warrior attacked.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, if applicable, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Resolve the Shriekwood Devourer trigger, untapping at least five lands.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1082-2232-2766-3872.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Swamp and at least one Forest that enter the battlefield untapped.
You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
You have at least one Swamp card and at least one Forest card that enter the battlefield untapped in your graveyard.
1082-2232-2766-3872.description:
Activate a Swamp and Forest by tapping them, adding {B}{G}.
Cast Molderhulk by paying {B}{G}.
When Molderhulk enters the battlefield, it, Dual Nature's first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger, creating a token copy of Molderhulk.
When the Molderhulk token enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Molderhulk from the battlefield to your hand.
When the nontoken Molderhulk leaves the battlefield, Dual Nature's second ability triggers, exiling the token Molderhulk.
Resolve the token Molderhulk's trigger from step 6, returning a Swamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the Swamp enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning another Swamp from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the nontoken Molderhulk's trigger from step 4, returning a Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the Forest enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning another Forest from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Land's Edge twice by discarding the Swamp and Forest, dealing 4 damage to any player or planeswalker.
Repeat.

1633-2060-3231-4120-5032.description:
Activate Bösium Strip by paying {3} and tapping it, allowing you to cast instants and sorceries from the top of your graveyard this turn.
Cast Hanabi Blast either from your hand or from the top of your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vigor's first ability, and then returning Hanabi Blast to your hand and discarding a card at random.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead target any other creature and/or player with Hanabi Blast.

262-859-4476.notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery attached to Lurking Roper.
262-859-4476.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating four 1/1 Elemental creature tokens.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield, they trigger Answered Prayers four times.
Resolve the first Answered Prayers trigger, causing you to gain one life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1913-2558-4659-4727.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 nonwhite creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
1913-2558-4659-4727.description:
Cause a 2/2 nonwhite creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1 creature due to Crovax.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Sword of the Meek, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the creature.
Imotekh triggers, holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Imotekh trigger, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens that enter the battlefield as 1/1 creatures due to Crovax.
Repeat from step 2.

413-1117-2478-4986.description:
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, looking at the top card of a player's library and drawing a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Junk Diver.
Junk Diver triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
